state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stage 10.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv playbook --triage <section>` is on disk (`tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts:707`). Sections `divergences`, `splitting-a-file`, `running-things`, `writing-a-test-case` and `writing-novis` are decided. `tooling` has 102 of its bullets still owed: every bullet whose file name sorts up to `an-ir-class-field-…` is decided, and every one after it is not.

The report's `LIVE MANIFEST` flag marks a bullet that any goal's manifest selects. Keep a bullet with that flag, or re-point its selectors first. Deleting one turns `bun nv chain --check` red, and that check is on the floor.

`tools/nv/cmd/orient.ts:77` selects every `a loop-goal.toml*` bullet as the family it prints when a check that should pass is red. Those bullets are kept with `[until: gone tools/nv/cmd/orient.ts:a loop-goal.toml*]`, so they go when that selector changes; only clear duplicates inside the family were deleted.

How the `tooling` batches were decided, so the second half matches the first:
- Deleted: bullets about `dossier.py`, `owners.py`, `# Known gaps` numbering, `carried-gaps.md`, the old `loop.py` internals, hand-editing plan fields, and perf figures going stale on a comment (the rule's `impl_hash` ignores comments and inline test modules now). Also deleted: python heredoc and python-script bullets, whose home is AGENTS.md rule 1, and duplicates of a bullet already kept.
- Kept on a python tool that still exists (`tools/peek.py`, `tools/rules.py`, `tools/plan.py`, `tools/reference.py`, `tools/check-migration.py`, `tools/goal-switch.py`): the trailer names that `.py` file, so Stage 12's deletion removes the bullet.
- Kept on the TS tool where the trap is about the new one: `tools/nv/driver/accept.ts:judgeTests`, `tools/nv/cmd/splice.ts:<<<<<<< OLD`, `tools/nv/cmd/peek.ts:re:`, `tools/nv/cmd/orient.ts:<a phrase it prints>`.

A batch changes both homes of a bullet: the fragment under `docs/agent/playbook/<section>/` and the record under `data/playbook/<section>/`. `.agent-tmp/triage-splitting.ts <batch.json>` is the batch script, and `.agent-tmp/triage-tooling-5.json` is the latest batch file. The script refuses the whole batch if a `gone` condition does not hold or a deleted bullet carries `LIVE MANIFEST`. A `gone` word must not contain `]`, because `]]` ends the trailer early; the script then throws after some keeps are written and before any delete, and re-running a fixed batch is safe. To fix a stale path in a kept bullet's text, Edit the fragment first; the script re-imports the record from it.

`awk '/^== /{p = /OWES A DECISION/} p'` over the report pulls the owed blocks, and `awk '/^== /{n++} n>=1 && n<=40'` takes one batch.

The goal-only sweep is red on the four checks later stages own: Stage 9's `audit checks`, Stage 11's `audit ci` and `loop-stats --guard`, and Stage 12's `audit python`, plus Stage 10's trailer check until `tooling` is triaged.
